basics.description: **XdrLogRaider** — Sentinel data connector for Microsoft Defender XDR portal-internal telemetry (`/apiproxy/`). Defender-only in v0.1.0; multi-portal in v0.2.0+.

basics.name: projectPrefix
basics.label: Project prefix
basics.toolTip: 3-12 char alphanumeric prefix for all resource names.

constraints.validationMessage: 3-12 lowercase alphanumerics, starting with a letter.

options.text: Select the Log Analytics workspace that has Microsoft Sentinel enabled. DCR + DCE will be region-aligned with the workspace; the Function App may live in any region.

elements.name: workspace
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace
elements.toolTip: Select the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace where Defender_*_CL tables will land. The DCR and DCE will be region-aligned with this workspace.

options.text: Provide a DEDICATED service account with Security Reader + Microsoft Defender Analyst. Exempt the SA from interactive-MFA / device-compliance Conditional Access policies (TOTP IS the MFA factor).

elements.name: password
elements.toolTip: The dedicated SA's password. Stored in the connector's Key Vault; never persisted in deployment history.

elements.name: authMethod
elements.label: MFA method
elements.toolTip: CredentialsTotp = SA uses TOTP from authenticator app. Passkey = SA uses ECDSA-P256 WebAuthn (zero-TOTP burns · KMSI 90d cookies still apply · PEM key must be registered via mysignins.microsoft.com).

elements.name: totp
elements.toolTip: Base32 secret from the SA's authenticator app (Security info → Microsoft Authenticator → 'Set up another way → Phone app' reveals the seed). REQUIRED when MFA method is CredentialsTotp.

elements.name: passkeyPem
elements.toolTip: PEM-encoded ECDSA-P256 private key for the SA's WebAuthn passkey (begins with '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----'). REQUIRED when MFA method is Passkey.

elements.name: planSku
elements.label: Function App plan SKU
elements.toolTip: Y1 = pay-per-execution ($0 idle). EP1+ = always-on; use for tenants where 10-min timeout is too tight.

elements.name: releaseTag
elements.label: Release tag
elements.toolTip: GitHub Release tag — leave 'latest' to auto-follow newest release (FA auto-pulls on cold-restart via /releases/latest/download/), or pin to v0.x.y for reproducible deploys.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 'latest' or a SemVer tag like 'v0.0.2'.

elements.name: deployRoleAssignments
elements.label: Deploy role assignments (requires User Access Administrator on this RG)
elements.toolTip: Uncheck if you only have Contributor; then run tools/Grant-Post-Deploy-Rbac.ps1 with a UAA-holding identity.
